dr_0008_status: Proposed - no DR-0008 value is ratified by this rubric

states.PASS: valid estimator/preparation/evidence, finite observation, complete coverage, within the preregistered limit
states.FAIL: valid evidence, observation outside the preregistered limit - a mismatch, never a tolerance problem
states.NO VERDICT: attempted evaluation cannot support a decision (unqualified estimator, floor-limited, preparation failure, open row); observation is null, never zero-as-pass
states.MISSING EVIDENCE: required input or capture absent; a distinct refusal state, never a numerical failure or pass

verdict_semantics.no_zero_error_pass: insufficient evidence is NO VERDICT, never a zero error or pass (DR-0004)

required: every mandatory row is PASS under this frozen rubric (an open mandatory row is NO VERDICT and blocks release)
zero MISSING EVIDENCE rows among mandatory rows
all required injected faults detected under the frozen configuration (R-L2-MM-COVERAGE)
coverage minimums met: development corpus QUALIFIED over the full 96-case denominator (R-L6-STRATA), case-registry required-row inventory satisfied (R-L0-P3)
development and holdout summaries kept mechanically separate; the holdout stays sealed until thresholds are frozen
appendix rows (perceptual, population) are reported and never gating
release_rule.independent_judge: numeric fitting may use a smooth development-only surrogate, but release judgment uses this frozen rubric; the optimizer objective must never be the sole acceptance judge; no tolerance is reverse-engineered from the candidate that must pass it
release_rule.no_aggregate: no omnibus scalar or incompatible-unit average controls release; results in different units are never averaged (DR-0004; docs/MEASUREMENT-PLAN.md reporting format)

preregistration.policy: measure, then preregister: every tolerance derives from an explicit numeric error budget and estimator floor, measured before preregistration, then preregistered as the smallest power of two >= 2x the measured value, before any RTL freeze (DR-0008 Section 10; operator ruling OQ5/C10)
preregistration.never_increase: thresholds are never increased after freeze (DR-0008 Section 10 calibration policy)
preregistration.miss_is_mismatch: a miss is a mismatch, never a tolerance problem (spec/PAIRED-METRICS.md; DR-0008 Section 10)
preregistration.no_post_hoc: no post-hoc tightening or loosening; no tolerance is reverse-engineered from the candidate that must pass it (issue #48 independent judge rule)
preregistration.new_tolerance_new_rubric: any later estimator or tolerance change creates rubric v1 and invokes the explicit holdout policy; a new tolerance does not rewrite the old scorecard (docs/MEASUREMENT-PLAN.md corpus strategy)

change_control.bump_rule: any change to an estimator, tolerance, coverage rule, or row set requires a new rubric version (v1 next); rubric v0 is frozen and never edited in place
change_control.holdout_policy_on_change: a new rubric version invokes the explicit holdout policy: the sealed 32-case holdout is revealed only after the new version's thresholds are frozen, and it never rewrites the old scorecard

holdout_seal.derivation_statement: no holdout artifact was read during the derivation of rubric v0: this rubric composes development/analyzer evidence only; the audit's denominator records holdout_identities_read = 0 (assertion in R-L1-R1)
holdout_seal.mechanical_separation: scorecard partitions development|holdout are validated as separate reports (spec/SCORECARD-CONTRACT.md v1); rubric rows are development-partition only
